name: Dead on Delivery
description:
About This Game

Dead on Delivery is a chaotic action roguelite that puts you in the shoes of a determined pizza delivery driver committed to completing his job—even in the middle of a zombie apocalypse! Play across 3 unique worlds, each filled with different hordes of the undead.

  • FIGHT, SURVIVE, AND EVOLVE

Defeat waves of enemies to progress and choose between random abilities after each stage (like "Allied UFO," "Moon Summoning," or even a "Rocket Launcher") to adapt to the chaos.

Strategic management: choose between speed, strength, or defense to survive—but be careful, time is running out and the pizza must stay hot!

  • POWERFUL POWER-UPS

Permanent death, continuous progression: each run unlocks upgrades, abilities, and new cards to make you stronger for the next battle.

COME BACK STRONGER!!!

Beyond the carnage, use the environment to your advantage: blow up fuel barrels, detonate cars, and crush zombies with your summons. But remember—the customer is always right... even if it’s a furious zombie craving your brain (and your pizza).

Prepare yourself for a bloody delivery, brutal challenges, and the burning question:

“Do you have what it takes to be the Hero (and Delivery Driver) of the Apocalypse?”
short_desc: Dead on Delivery is a fast-paced top-down action roguelite where you play as a pizza delivery driver in a zombie apocalypse, facing relentless hordes of the undead in intense arena combat while using improvised weapons and strategic abilities to create unique builds and survive each new run.
